shots.title: Parse decimal sprint overrides in status command (#511)
shots.notes: `slope status` now uses the shared `parseSprintNumber` parser instead of truncating decimal sprint ids with `parseInt`.

shots.title: Add decimal and invalid sprint status regressions (#511)
shots.notes: Added regressions for `--sprint=143.5` preserving the decimal label and malformed sprint values exiting with the shared sprint-id guidance.

conditions.description: The Windows full suite continues to emit known temp-repo stderr, CRLF, and path warnings, but all tests passed.
`slope map --check` and `slope commit-ready --json` leaked `The system cannot find the path specified.` to stderr from Unix-style git redirection; raised as #512 and triaged into S143.7.

training.description: Every CLI surface that accepts sprint ids should use the shared parser.
training.outcome: `status --sprint=143.5` now displays S143.6/S143.5-style decimal sprint contexts instead of silently truncating to S143.

training.description: Validate malformed flags before opening command-specific stores when possible.
training.outcome: The status command now resolves and rejects invalid sprint flags before opening the SLOPE store.

nutrition.description: `corepack pnpm vitest run tests/cli/commands/status.test.ts` passed: 4 tests.
`corepack pnpm typecheck`, `corepack pnpm prepare`, and `corepack pnpm test` passed on Windows: 229 test files passed, 1 skipped; 3625 tests passed, 25 skipped.
`slope roadmap validate` passed with existing historical roadmap warnings.
`node dist/cli/index.js status --sprint=143.6` displayed S143.6 claims, and `status --sprint=143.nope` exited with the expected invalid-sprint guidance.

nineteenth_hole.how_did_it_feel: Small and satisfying. The issue was a direct parser mismatch, and the shared parser snapped the command back into line.
nineteenth_hole.advice_for_next_player: When adding decimal sprint support, grep for `parseInt` on sprint flags and replace it with `parseSprintNumber` unless there is a proven integer-only contract.
nineteenth_hole.what_surprised_you: The runtime smoke surfaced an unrelated Windows stderr leak in the map staleness path, which commit-ready inherits.
nineteenth_hole.excited_about_next: S143.7 can clear the stderr leak so release validation is quieter and JSON callers get clean command streams.

bunker_locations: `parseInt` silently truncates decimal sprint ids; sprint CLI flags should use `parseSprintNumber`.
Unix shell redirection like `2>/dev/null` leaks Windows stderr under `cmd.exe`; prefer child-process stdio options.
yardage_book_updates: `statusCommand` rejects invalid sprint flags before opening the SLOPE store.
`tests/cli/commands/status.test.ts` covers decimal sprint overrides and invalid sprint guidance.
course_management_notes: Issue #511 should close when the PR containing S143.6 merges.
Issue #512 is triaged into S143.7 before the release sprint.
